For visitors

Please RSVP on Meetup; there is a paper sign-up at the start. Check your tires, bring water bottles, a tire repair kit and a spare tube. Helmet mandatory. There are no restrooms at the start.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–14 mph: relaxed, with time to talk. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Fran's Usual Friday C/C+ Ride (Outdoor Club of South Jersey) group ride

Fran's Usual Friday C/C+ Ride (Outdoor Club of South Jersey) is a road and social group ride in Medford, NJ. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Taunton Forge Shopping Center.

A Friday-morning no-drop social ride of 25 to 30 miles from Medford at 13 to 14 mph. The host asks for a bike check, water and a repair kit.
